zt25xSWSjrqAwTidZiT2Xg.zh: 多明加共和國聖克里斯多福省一處拘留所爆發群聚,於今年7/28報告9例疑個案(均為收容人),目前經RT-PCR確診2例,餘7 例調查中,尚無社區傳播情形,當局已進行接觸者追蹤與環境消毒。該國於2022年至2024年累計83例確定病例後,已近2年無發生疫情。
zt25xSWSjrqAwTidZiT2Xg.en: A cluster has emerged at a detention centre in San Cristóbal Province, Dominican Republic. On 28 July this year, 9 suspected cases, all of them detainees, were reported. Two have been confirmed by RT-PCR, and the remaining 7 are under investigation. No community transmission has been identified, and authorities have conducted contact tracing and environmental disinfection. Following a cumulative total of 83 confirmed cases recorded from 2022 to 2024, the country has gone almost two years without an outbreak.

f-2oNDP2aY5q_keV-VWPNA.en: The Dominican Republic reported 178 cumulative cases in 2025 up to 13 December, including 18 deaths. The number of cases was 2.75 times the same period last year. Authorities said that there have been recent delays in notification and in seeking medical care, and called for strengthened community health education and notification mechanisms.

CLyzW0hWqL4H8KJMu9ebGQ.en: The Dominican Republic reported 26 notified cases cumulatively this year as of 6 December, 13 of which were fatal. Both case numbers and deaths rose sharply compared with the same period last year (8 cases and 2 deaths). Authorities update surveillance information only through weekly reports and have not published any related outbreak investigation or specific control measures.

IXQVa5Jqw25rkoWJEMdTzg.en: Dominican Republic epidemic update: Last year, up to week 48, 984 cases were reported cumulatively, up from 265 in the same period of the previous year. Cases are concentrated in Azua Province in the south of the country, which has the most cases. Authorities continue to implement prevention and control measures to avoid transmission.

bCHcmwgzWy9mJGMKwdL2-Q.en: Brazil epidemic update: Last year, 6,565,716 cases and 5,954 deaths were reported cumulatively. The age distribution is highest among people aged 20–29, followed by 30–39 and 40–49. Incidence is higher in the central and southern parts of the country, with São Paulo State reporting the most cases. Dominican Republic epidemic update: Last year, 1,284 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively, a decrease of 65.54% from the previous year. Incidence is highest in San José de Ocoa Province in the south.

Yemen: In Taiz Governorate in south-western Yemen, cases are rising. So far this year, 4,338 cases have been cumulatively reported, with no deaths.
